item.title: Chow-Witt Theory in the Arrowtic Paradigm
item.description: arXiv:2607.17010v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this article we propose a theory of Chow-Witt groups, in the paradigm of Quillen's arrow based approach to $K$-theory. We refer to this style of arguments as arrowtic paradigm. Other than establishing the machinery needed to work in this paradigm, we establish the homotopy invariance property of the Arrowtic Chow-Witt groups. We also compute the arrowtic Chow-Witt groups of the projective spaces, over fields.
item.dc:creator: Satya Mandal

item.title: Classifying $^*$-homomorphisms I: Unital simple nuclear $C^*$-algebras
item.description: arXiv:2307.06480v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We classify the unital embeddings of a unital separable nuclear $C^*$-algebra satisfying the universal coefficient theorem into a unital simple separable nuclear $C^*$-algebra that tensorially absorbs the Jiang--Su algebra. This gives a new and essentially self-contained proof of the stably finite case of the unital classification theorem: unital simple separable nuclear $C^*$-algebras that absorb the Jiang--Su algebra tensorially and satisfy the universal coefficient theorem are classified by Elliott's invariant of $K$-theory and traces.
item.dc:creator: Jos\'e R. Carri\'on, James Gabe, Christopher Schafhauser, Aaron Tikuisis, Stuart White
